Event: Kelbury offsite, Tuesday. Capacity: 200.
Staffing: Teo out (Cora covering); Ines out (Pia replacing Mira); Vik out (Leon covering); Greta out (Cora covering); Una out (Kira covering); Ada out (Wren covering); Jonah out (Opal covering); Finn out (Dell covering); Wren out (Opal covering); Kira out (Nils covering); Leon out (Opal covering). Suri/Wren swap desks; Ada/Teo swap desks.
Room/Equipment:
- Coffee machines working in loading bay, garden studio, harbour room, print room, library annex, north office, east wing.
- Repainting: North office/East wing (evening noise); Library annex (morning noise).
- Lifts slow near loading bay/library annex, harbour room, garden studio, north office.
- Umbrellas: Garden studio, East wing, harbour room, print room. One in loading bay, one in harbour room. New umbrella in garden studio. Umbrella left in print room.
- Stand-ups: Morning in North office; Evening moved to East wing.
- Room Preferences/Status:
  - Esme: Library annex clear for visitors.
  - Ines: Loading bay clear (evening cold); asked if North office free afternoon.
  - Hugo: East wing free afternoon? Harbour room free evening?
  - Dell: Prefers loading bay for reviews. Asked if loading bay free afternoon.
  - Una: Prefers harbour room for reviews; thinks print room too cold afternoon. Asked if North office free morning.
  - Cora: Prefers North office for reviews; thinks loading bay too cold in morning.
  - Teo: Prefers garden studio for reviews; print room cold evening; asked if East wing free evening.
  - Mira: Prefers East wing for reviews; prefers print room for reviews.
  - Nils: North office too cold in morning.
  - Bram: Harbour room too cold in evening. Prefers print room for reviews.
  - Suri: Asked if print room free in evening.
- Action Items:
  - Send Mira, Dell, Kira, Suri, Cora, and Ines evening meeting notes.
  - Send Teo evening meeting notes.
  - Check with Wren, Opal, Rafe, Vik before respective meetings.
  - Check if loading bay free afternoon (Pia/Jonah/Dell asked).
  - Check if harbour room free morning (Jonah asked).
  - Keep print room clear for Suri/visitors.
  - Vik wants harbour room clear for visitors.
  - Check if garden studio is free in the evening (Pia asked).
  - Send Dell afternoon meeting notes.
  - Send Greta afternoon meeting notes.
  - Remind later that Bram prefers print room for reviews.
  - Check with Suri before morning meeting.
